title.en: Learning to route, across spatial scales.
title.zh: 从空间聚类到路径决策。

role.en: Project leader · Advisor: Prof. Guangyu Zou, DUT
role.zh: 项目负责人 · 导师：大连理工大学 Guangyu Zou 教授

description.en: This project develops CAADRL for pickup-and-delivery problems with pairing and precedence constraints in spatially clustered instances. Global self-attention and intra-cluster attention capture multiscale structure; a hierarchical decoder handles route selection within and between clusters.
description.zh: 本项目面向具有空间聚类结构的取送货问题，在配对与先后顺序约束下构建 CAADRL 模型。通过全局自注意力和簇内注意力提取多尺度空间特征，再以分层解码器处理簇内路径选择与簇间转移。

alt.en: CAADRL architecture from the research manuscript, showing its attention encoder and routing decoder.
alt.zh: 论文中的 CAADRL 模型架构，展示注意力编码器与路径解码器。

description.en: This project proposes MC-TRCM to fuse heterogeneous mobile and wearable features under substantial missingness. Feature-source tokens and missing-aware gating feed a conditioned Transformer; recursive decoding refines predictions across six regression and classification tasks on DepreST-CAT and PSYCHE-D.
description.zh: 本项目提出 MC-TRCM，在大量缺失观测下融合异构移动设备与可穿戴特征。以特征源 token 和缺失感知门控结合条件化 Transformer，再通过递归解码细化预测；在 DepreST-CAT 与 PSYCHE-D 的六个回归和分类任务上开展评估。

alt.en: MC-TRCM architecture from the research manuscript, showing observation-aware tokens, fusion, and recursive refinement.
alt.zh: 论文中的 MC-TRCM 架构，展示观测感知 token、特征融合与递归细化。
